title: the Lord is my shepherd

verses.text: The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.

caption:
Being led is not the same as being left to figure it out.

A shepherd goes ahead of the flock. He knows where the grass is green and where the water runs quiet, and he stops you long enough to be restored. You are not behind. You are being guided.

Psalm 23:1, 23:2 and 23:3 (BSB)
